en: The image shows a historical, colorized photograph of a military parade or procession. Soldiers in uniform are marching in formation through a city square, observed by civilians, including women and children. The buildings in the background have European architectural styles typical of the late 19th or early 20th century. Text is printed at the bottom in Dutch, referencing 'Nijmegen' and the return of the Colonial Reserve at the Valkhof barracks.
